features: Governance context (D5.4) tab in the Response module: barrier and enabler cards from D5.4 Tables 5-7 per demonstration area, and recommendation cards with Add to register (WS-9a).
Load DA actor list and a D5.4 roles column (Newton & Elliott typology) in PIMS stakeholders (WS-9a).
Greenland, Faroe Islands and seven regional bodies (NEAFC, ICES, GFCM, ACCOBAMS, Pelagos, MedPAN, Nordic Council) in the country database (WS-9a).
Curated governance profiles in data/wp5_governance_profiles.json, verified word for word against deliverable D5.4 (WS-9a).

medium: Adding a second stakeholder, engagement, communication or response measure created duplicate rows (since 1.16.5).
Scenario Builder impact analysis crashed on scenarios that remove a link.
Added links failed to bind to baseline edges that carry extra columns.
performance: ML connection suggestions: batch graph-feature extraction computes paths, neighbours and centrality once per call instead of per pair; 2000 pairs on a 200-node network went from 35 s to 0.2 s with identical output (1.26.1).
high: Auto-save backups wrote empty fields without null, so recovery could drop a whole element category; the loader now binds rows by key union, so older backups recover too (WS-4).

migration_notes: Projects that use a WP5 indicator are stamped min_app_version 1.24.0; 1.23.0 and older would drop the indicator columns on save.

Projects with an intervention-designer scenario that re-weights links (links_modified) are stamped min_app_version 1.28.0; 1.27.0 and older would ignore the re-weights and show the scenario as unchanged.
Projects that use the new governance fields (D5.4 roles, Policy_Target) need app 1.30.0.
